findings.root_cause: Turn state was not a complete recovery source.

findings.evidence: S1 manifest/bundle and named S2/S3/S4 consumer digest gates form an executable immutable handoff.
findings.root_cause: Byte identity lacked an artifact flow.

findings.evidence: S2-1/2 persist and compare the complete binding and require one pre-consume negative per field.

Authority and S4 uniformly use /ws/realtime-voice with full wiring tests.
S2-6 scopes exact deploy/compose mechanics, backup, admission, predecessor retention and rollback.

findings.evidence: Two-slot authority and matrix plus 45-permutation spike remove dependency on undocumented event order.

findings.evidence: The first wallet revision expires 2026-09-28 and the reviewed plan/architecture had no successor creation, selection, handoff, or expiry gate.
findings.root_cause: A short-lived revision entered negotiated capability without a production rollover lifecycle.
